subject: What credentials does the shiny server run under?

messages.author: 556c9814a6b7a62c
messages.subject: What credentials does the shiny server run under?
parts:
Within a shiny web application I am trying to load a .RData file that contains a data.frame (example.RData file) and then after I append additional rows save back the file.  However, has an error when trying to save the file.  The Javascript console showed the error below.  I tried to change the permissions for this file using linux commands but still get the error.  When I comment out the "save" line of code that saves the .RData the web application runs as expected.  When I run the app from Rstudio it works fine and saves the .RData file as expected.  Thanks for any insight trying to save this file!  

Warning in gzfile(file, "wb") :

  cannot open compressed file 'example.RData', probable reason 'Permission denied'

Warning: Unhandled error in observer: cannot open the connection

observeEvent(input$connect)
